comparison.objective: Cut foam along a printed curve using a fixed hot ribbon versus adjust and validate damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuously translate and rotate work relative to a cutting tool versus small-tool engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and repeated mechanical testing.
comparison.success_condition: Follow the printed curve with appropriate ribbon alignment versus obtain two compliant stops and preserve the locked setting.
comparison.reason: No meaningful tested-ability overlap. The foam record lacks numeric path-error, cut-quality, damage, and completion thresholds.
